rows.quote: Validation analyses were conducted using GWAS summary statistics from the FinnGen R12 release, including the six sepsis-related phenotypes available in this release: “Other septicemia”, “Streptococcal septicemia”, “Puerperal sepsis”, “Bacterial sepsis of newborn”, “Pneumococcal septicemia”, and “Hemophilus septicemia”.
rows.coder_note: Step 2 (rule A): 'the FinnGen R12 release' gives release R12, repeated in four other passages with no other release named; FinnGen is used alone as the validation dataset, so the R12 meta-analysis rows are not named. Reference 13 (Kurki 2023) covers every FinnGen row and is not used.

Step 4: the sepsis summary statistics are stated to come from publicly available GWAS of the UK Biobank cohort (11,643 cases, 474,841 controls), so the phenotype definition describes a published GWAS and not the authors' own analysis of individual-level data, and rule C does not apply; the citations given (reference 12, Bycroft 2018; reference 15, Hamilton 2023, DOI 10.1371/journal.pmed.1004174) are no dictionary row's source identifier and cannot carry a code; no accession or release is given; the outcome side has UK Biobank rows, so C2 does not apply (rules D, I1).
